transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I keep making these small mistakes on things I thought I’d checked. Like applications or research notes—sometimes I’ll miss a question or label something wrong, like an artwork date. It’s embarrassing, and it’s been happening enough that I thought I should ask about it.
Since childhood, have you often had trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes?

Yeah… I think so. It’s mostly small stuff, but it adds up. Like, I’ll turn in an application or some research notes and later notice I skipped a question or wrote the wrong date for an artwork, even though I really thought I’d checked it. It’s kind of embarrassing.
Do these kinds of attention mistakes happen in more than one part of your life, like both at work or school and at home?

Yeah… I mean, I notice it most with applications or research notes. I’ll think I checked everything, then later realize I skipped a question or put the wrong date on an artwork or something. I guess it’s not just one specific place—it kind of shows up wherever I have to fill things out carefully.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to pay attention?

Yeah… I do. Like if I’m reading or writing at my desk, something small—a siren outside, people talking in the hall, or just some random thought about an exhibit idea—can pull me off track. Then I’ll realize, like, twenty minutes went by.
Before age 12, were you already having these kinds of attention problems?

Yeah… I think so. In elementary school, teachers would say I had good ideas, but I’d forget to turn in worksheets or lose the instructions. My parents had to check my backpack most nights, or I’d miss little details.
Have these attention problems caused significant trouble in your work, school, or daily responsibilities?

Yeah… I guess it has. I’ve turned things in late, and I missed a couple application deadlines. One of my mentors told me my follow-through was starting to hurt opportunities I should’ve been ready for, so… yeah, it’s been a problem.
Do you get unwanted thoughts that keep coming back and make you feel like you have to check things over and over?
Um… not really. I mean, I might double-check something if I’m unsure, but I don’t think I get stuck with thoughts that force me to keep checking over and over.
Do you spend a lot of your day worrying about different things, even when you try not to?
Not really… I mean, I worry about stuff sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it takes up a lot of my day or anything.
